Name: Cat Valley Bags
Author: shalassa
Description:
[size=4][center][b]Coming to your favourite FS store: Cat Valley Bags[/b][/center][/size]


This mod is as simple and straightforward as it sounds: You can now wear the gorgeous backpack upgrades from the Cat Valley UI. All you need for that is having Fashion Sense.

If you like this mod, please also leave your thanks and endorsement over at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39379]Cat Valley(Interface) [/url]﻿because without that mod, this one would never exist to begin with as my mod uses its assets, just slightly altered to fit the farmer's body.

This mod was made with the default body in mind. I do not use any body-changing mods so cannot guarantee a perfect fit for them.



[b][u][size=4]Requirements:[/size][/u][/b]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]

Highly recommended:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39379]Cat Valley(Interface)[/url]



[size=4][u][b]Installation:[/b][/u][/size]

Just drop it into the ./Mods folder created by SMAPI (or any other subsequent folders if you are like me and organise your mods)
Or use your favourite mod manager to install it.


[size=4][b][u]Uninstallation:[/u][/b][/size]

Just delete it from ./Mods
Or use your favourite mod manager to delete it.



[b][center]Credits[/center][/b][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/RimeNovi?gameId=1303]RimeNovi[/url] for making such a pretty mod and giving me permissions to share this mod.
